items.q: What kind of projects do you take?
a: Form and concept design for household goods, furniture, technology products, ceramics and handcrafted pieces.
I also take on 3D modelling and rendering for ideas that already exist.

items.q: How long does a project take?
a: It depends on the depth. A straightforward form proposal can be done in one to two weeks, while a project needing user research and a prototype takes longer.
Once I understand the brief I will give you a clear schedule.
Yes. I built a full-scale prototype for my graduation project, and have prototyped and paint-finished a number of smaller products.

items.q: What do I receive at the end?
a: Usually the 3D model files, a render set and technical drawings detailed enough to discuss with a factory.
The exact list is agreed at the start of the project.
